query: select game,payload from ml_private.daily_catalogue where concat(payload->>'q',' ',payload->>'s',' ',payload->>'l',' ',payload->>'r',' ',payload->>'source') ~* '(squash|squashofficiating|squashregeln|not up|hand out)'
limits: Entire catalogue scanned by subject/terminology; no Jeopardy bank in Daily. No player data read.
